Kraan.setting: the bare peak of a steep hill, a forest canopy on the slopes below
Kraan.prompt: A Kraan: a huge flying beast, with vast dark bat-like wings whose ribbed edges end in hooked claws, a long tapering body with a scaly back, clawed feet and a long head with a mouth full of razor-sharp fangs; saddle straps cross its back. It dives out of the sky at the viewer, wings beating hard enough to buffet a man off his feet, its fanged jaws snapping shut just short of the viewer's head.
beyond: ribbed, clawed wing edges, saddle straps: ill3
long head, clawed feet: ill3

Vordak.setting: a narrow forest track among close trees
Vordak.prompt: A Vordak: a tall undead figure standing upright on two legs as a man does, in long, ragged hooded robes, the hood drooping over a hideous, fleshless face with deep-set glinting eyes, skeletal fingers gripping a huge, heavy dark mace. It has just spun round on the track; with a piercing, blood-freezing scream it raises the mace high above its head and charges at the viewer, a chilling force pressing out from it at the mind.
beyond: spiked mace head: ill3
drooping hood: ill8
glinting eyes: my guess

Black Bear.setting: a small wooded hilltop ringed by large boulders
Black Bear.prompt: A huge bear with a thick, shaggy dark coat, heavy shoulders and long curved claws, badly wounded, blood running from wounds in its neck and back. On all fours, it comes slowly out from behind a boulder, growling, head low, mouth open, its face creased with pain and fury, closing on the viewer.
beyond: shaggy coat, long curved claws, head low: my guess

Giak.setting: the ruins of a forest temple among tall pines, broken stone pillars and fallen blocks
Giak.prompt: A Giak: a small, ugly goblin-like soldier, much shorter than a man, wiry and stooped, standing on two legs as a man does, with man-like arms ending in clawed hands, coarse ashen hide, a broad snarling face with a wide mouth of jagged fangs, a heavy flat nose and pale glaring eyes full of malice, in a tall pointed helmet of dull bronze riveted round its rim and a jerkin of studded leather. It has scuttled up a broken stone pillar and now leaps down from its top, a long curved dagger clenched in its teeth and its clawed hands outstretched, straight at the viewer.
beyond: riveted helmet rim, studded leather jerkin: ill4 and small9
jagged fangs, heavy flat nose: ill4 (the front Giak's face)
clawed hands, much shorter than a man: my guess from "small"
tall pines: ill9

Madman.setting: a broad city street, a doorway with its door flung open
Madman.prompt: A decrepit, wild old man, quite insane: a long, straggling beard, wide staring eyes behind small round spectacles, a floppy cap with a feather, a loose stained smock and patched hose. He bursts out through the door, screaming curses and accusations, deaf to all reason, a heavy meat cleaver raised high in one bony hand to hack at the viewer.
beyond: beard, staring eyes, spectacles, feathered cap, smock, patched hose: ill6

Giak + Doomwolf.setting: a path through sparse, hilly forest, leading down to an open meadow
Giak + Doomwolf.prompt: A Giak riding its Doomwolf, the pair as one foe. The Giak: a small, ugly goblin-like soldier, sneering, with coarse ashen hide, a fanged mouth and pale glaring eyes, in a tall pointed helmet of dull bronze and a jerkin of studded leather, unsheathing a curved scimitar. Its mount: a large, vicious wolf big enough to carry it, shaggy fur bristling, snarling, its razor-fanged jaws wide. They come along the path straight at the viewer, the rider's blade rising.
beyond: studded leather jerkin: ill4 and small9
shaggy bristling fur: ill4, small17, 09tcof ill9

Giaks.setting: a country road at dusk, a broken-down wagon with one wheel jammed in a furrow
Giaks.prompt: Three Giaks: small, ugly goblin-like soldiers, much shorter than men, wiry and stooped, standing on two legs as men do, with coarse ashen hide, broad snarling faces with wide fanged mouths, heavy flat noses and pale glaring eyes full of malice, in tall pointed helmets of dull bronze and jerkins of studded leather. Just dropped to the ground, they advance together, shoulder to shoulder in a low crouch, and thrust long spears with serrated points at the viewer.
beyond: studded leather jerkins: ill4 and small9
fanged mouths, heavy flat noses: ill4 (the front Giak's face)
shoulder to shoulder in a low crouch: my guess, for a group fought as one

Winged Serpent.setting: an underground stone chamber, a granite throne with a glowing bowl on it, a dark stone floor
Winged Serpent.prompt: A large winged serpent, freshly burst from the stone statue that hid it: a long scaled snake body in an S curve, a wedge-shaped reptile head with open jaws, long fangs and a forked tongue, cold lidless eyes, and a pair of broad leathery bat wings spread wide from behind its head. Cracked shards and dust of its stone shell still fly from its body as it rears up off its plinth and lunges straight at the viewer, wings beating, jaws wide to strike. The serpent alone, no rider, no person.
beyond: leathery bat wings: small16 (the statue)
scaled body, fangs, lidless eyes: my guess, from small16 and 09tcof ill5

Crypt Spawn.setting: a large stone chamber, two facing rows of skulls on stone plinths making a walkway, an eerie glow from the skulls, an archway beyond
Crypt Spawn.prompt: Crypt Spawn: ten hideous, slimy winged creatures, each the size of a cat, with a lumpy, folded body like a bare brain, small leathery bat wings, rows of suckers and long trailing bony limbs. Just hatched from skulls that have split open with a crack, they stretch their wings, rise together and swarm at the viewer.
beyond: brain-like body, bat wings, suckers, bony limbs: the fan wiki and 05sots ill14
size of a cat: my guess

Burrowcrawler.setting: a pitch-dark tunnel through a hillside, wider than it is high, roots hanging at its mouth
Burrowcrawler.prompt: A Burrowcrawler: a giant, heavy, slimy grub longer than a man, with a fat ringed body, a plated, spiny back, six jointed insect legs and a curling tail ending in a stinger; its blunt head bears snapping jaws amid a mass of long, writhing, slimy tentacles. It drops heavily from the tunnel roof onto the viewer, tentacles reaching to coil round the throat and strangle, a stench of rotting meat about it.
beyond: ringed body, plated back, jointed legs: ill11
stinger tail, six legs: the fan wiki

Leader.setting: a small footbridge on a country road
Leader.prompt: A rough-looking, unshaven bandit posing as a soldier, bloodstained, wearing a stolen garrison tunic, a crossbow slung over the pack on his back, and a costly, lavishly decorated sword far too fine for him. Having demanded money or life, he attacks the viewer with the ornate blade.
beyond: the sword: the book says three swords and a crossbow among the three of them

Soldier.setting: a small footbridge on a country road
Soldier.prompt: A bloodstained, unshaven bandit passing himself off as a soldier, in rough, stained clothes, an evil grin on his face, holding a costly, lavishly decorated sword far too fine for him. He rushes at the viewer, blade raised.
beyond: rough, stained clothes, blade raised: my guess

Bodyguard.setting: the open top half of a covered wagon's rear door, a road racing past below
Bodyguard.prompt: A burly bodyguard, broad, with an angry, suspicious face, in a sleeveless jerkin. Leaning out of the flung-open top half of a wagon's rear door, he unsheathes a large curved scimitar and slashes at the viewer's head.
beyond: burly, broad, sleeveless jerkin: my guess, from 06tkot ill3

Marshviper.setting: a wooded marsh, waist-deep slimy water, the air thick with stinging insects
Marshviper.prompt: A Marshviper: a long, thick-bodied venomous water snake with slick scales, its coils wrapped tight round the viewer's leg under the murky, slimy water, its flat wedge head rearing out of the water to strike, fangs bared.
beyond: thick body, slick scales, flat wedge head, fangs: my guess (the book names it and its bite only)

Robber.setting: a small, dark, musty shop, shelves of books and bottles of every size, a glass-topped counter, a toppling bamboo screen
Robber.prompt: A young, swarthy robber, lean and quick, in plain clothes, gripping a long, curved dagger. He bursts out from behind a crashing bamboo screen and leaps at the viewer, the blade thrust forward.
beyond: lean, plain clothes: my guess

Drakkar.setting: a small ferry boat out on a wide, still lake, a wooded shore far behind
Drakkar.prompt: A Drakkar: a strong warrior standing up in a small poled ferry boat, throwing back the hood of a heavy cloak to reveal a fearsome war-helm with a full face mask shaped like a snarling skull, crested with curling, horn-like flanges; a short sword in his fist. Laughing menacingly behind the mask, he raises the sword at the viewer.
beyond: war-helm, skull mask, curling crests: ill14

Doomwolf.setting: a woodland path sloping down to an open meadow
Doomwolf.prompt: A Doomwolf: a large, vicious wolf far bigger than any common wolf, big enough to carry a rider, with a coarse shaggy coat bristling along the neck and back, a long muzzle, ears laid back and a snarling mouth packed with razor-sharp fangs. One of four that come on one after another, it charges down the path at full stretch on all fours, straight at the viewer, jaws wide. The beast alone.
beyond: shaggy bristling coat: 09tcof ill9 and Book 3 (section 89)
ears laid back, long muzzle: my guess

Gourgaz.setting: a stone bridge in a forest, spent arrows on its stones
Gourgaz.prompt: A Gourgaz: a giant, cold-blooded reptile warrior standing upright on two legs as a man does: a heavy, scaly, pebbled hide, a ridged belly, a long snout-like head with heavy-lidded eyes and a lipless mouth, and clawed hands and feet. A man in build, a reptile in skin, head and claws. It raises a great dark axe above its scaly head to strike down at the viewer.
beyond: upright stance, pebbled hide, ridged belly, double blade of the axe: ill7
heavy-lidded eyes, lipless mouth: my guess
arrows on the bridge: my guess, from the arrows flying past
